name: Sit to stand
description: Rising from a seated position to standing, then sitting back down. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Sit on a stable chair, side-on to the screen, feet flat on the floor.
Sit back down in a controlled way.

camera.guidance: Place the chair side-on to the camera so your hip, knee and ankle stay in view while sitting and standing.

messages.target_not_reached: Stand up fully before sitting back down.

form_rules.message: Stand tall at the top of the movement.

setup: Use a stable chair without wheels, placed side-on to the screen, with something sturdy nearby to hold if your therapist advised it.
Sit near the front of the seat with your feet flat and hip-width apart.

cues.start: Seated, feet flat on the floor.
cues.move: Lean forward slightly and stand up fully.
cues.back: Sit back down slowly and with control.

key_points: Stand up all the way before sitting down again.
Sit down slowly; avoid dropping into the chair.
Keep your feet in place throughout.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds up and 3 seconds down.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
